_comment: Use with: python3 server.py --role driver --scenario scenarios/driver_mode.json. Personas here are RIDERS. Trigger a request for one from the dashboard's 'Trigger a rider request' form. Fire two in quick succession against the same real driver app to test concurrent-offer handling.
_geography: Mirror image of rider_mode.json: these are rider PICKUP points, and they sit in kwella's real operating geography (Philippi / Nyanga / Gugulethu) rather than the Cape Town CBD. _match_and_push_offer only pushes an offer to a driver within _TRIP_MATCH_RADIUS_M (5000 m) of the pickup, so a real driver app running in the operating geography — reference position, the Philippi anchor (-34.0103967, 18.6156183) that rider_mode.json uses — matches all three: nomsa ~1148 m, jason ~2912 m, priya ~3681 m. The old CBD coordinates sat ~20 km out, so a driver testing in Philippi never received an offer at all.
